title: Peering TCP port has no authentication
description: transit/main.rs:352-361: peering connections accepted without any authentication — no API key, no mTLS, no peer identity challenge. The peers.addresses config list is never used for access control. Any host that can reach the port can inject articles. The per-session token bucket limits rate but not identity. Fix: add a required authentication mechanism (whitelist by IP, shared secret handshake, or TLS client cert) before production deployment. At minimum, document that the port MUST be firewalled.
